topic.title: September inflation hits 5.54%: savings account versus FD, which one still beats prices

title: Prices are up 5.54% in a year. Does your savings account keep pace?
description: September's retail inflation came in at 5.54% (MoSPI). We put ₹1 lakh in a savings account at an assumed 3% and in an FD at an assumed 7% for 5 years, and compare both with prices rising at that pace. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.

lines.text: Prices in India rose 5.54% in a year. Is your money keeping up?
My money sits in a savings account. That's safe, right?
At that pace, shopping that costs ₹1,00,000 today will cost ₹1.3 L in 5 years.
Park ₹1,00,000 in an FD at 7%: you get ₹1.4 L. A savings account at 3% gives just ₹1.2 L.
Line them up. The savings account falls behind prices. The FD stays ahead, before tax.
Safe is not enough. Does it grow faster than prices?
Is yours keeping up? Follow for one money idea a day.
